Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Ember Spinal System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3.0 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 40 T/m.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg.
- No more than 30 minutes of active scan time per session.
- Followed by a wait time of 60 minutes.
The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
